# Tiny Swords Vendor Assets

- Pack: Tiny Swords (Free Pack)

- Local source used for vendoring: `/Users/lio/Downloads/Tiny Swords (Free Pack)`
- License / usage terms: follow the current upstream itch.io pack terms

Included subdirectories:

- `terrain/tileset/Tilemap_color{1..5}.png`
- `terrain/decorations/rocks/Rock{1..4}.png`
- `terrain/decorations/bushes/Bushe{1..4}.png`
